_comment: Upmc - performance-focused Purpur/Paper fork egg. Requires Java 25. Import via Admin Panel > Nests > (select a nest) > Import Egg.
name: Upmc
author: MrFrenchGuy23
description: Upmc - a performance-focused Purpur (Paper) fork for Minecraft 26.2. Requires Java 25 (ghcr.io/pterodactyl/yolks:java_25).

installation.script:
#@!/bin/bash
# Upmc egg install script
if [ ! -d /mnt/server ]; then
  mkdir -p /mnt/server
fi
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${SERVER_JAR_URL}" ]; then
  echo -e "No download URL set. Upload upmc.jar manually via the File Manager."
else
  echo -e "Downloading Upmc jar..."
  curl -sSL -o "${SERVER_JAR}" "${SERVER_JAR_URL}"
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo -e "Download failed. Check the URL."
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Accept EULA
if [ ! -f eula.txt ]; then
  echo -e "eula=true" > eula.txt
fi

echo -e "Install complete."

variables.name: Jar name
variables.description: The name of the Upmc jar to run. Defaults to upmc.jar - keep this in sync with the file you upload/download.

variables.name: Jar download URL
variables.description: Direct URL to the Upmc jar (e.g. a GitHub release asset). Defaults to the V1 release. Leave empty to upload the jar manually via File Manager.

variables.name: Java opts
variables.description: Aikar's flags - tuned G1GC settings for stable TPS.
